description: Detects deepfakes via absence/irregularity of heartbeat-driven skin color signal.

known_failure_modes.effect: unreliable pulse signal extraction, high false-negative rate
insufficient signal for a stable pulse reading
misleading confident-but-wrong result (e.g. false periodic noise mistaken for a real pulse, incorrect 'authentic' verdict)

reliability_notes: Best used as a secondary, explainability-focused signal — not a sole authority, especially in poor lighting, short clips, or when the face is partially occluded.
